verdict.rationale: Jitsu's MCP server and Management API let an agent manage the pipeline: create destinations, wire streams, inspect Live Events, and edit Functions. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent querying customer or profile data, or creating and activating audiences or segments, through these interfaces. Warehouse querying appears only as a Functions-internal building block (ctx.getWarehouse), and Profile Builder writes profiles to the warehouse with no documented audience creation or activation API, so both are adjacent capabilities rather than the story itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can query customer data and create or activate audiences end to end through documented APIs or MCP — no dashboard in the loop
